answer_1.quote: We refer to abstractive summarization in this paper ... Unsupervised text summarization is still developing ...
answer_1.outputs: Generated summaries (shortened sentences) for input documents

answer_2.quote: In our quantitative analysis, we examine the ROUGE scores ... ROUGE scores are computed with summaries capped at the first 75 bytes.

answer_4.quote: We manually checked more than 200 summaries for each model and each dataset ... We manually assess the summaries produced by each model and sum up their pros and cons.
answer_4.guideline: The manual assessment considered criteria such as grammaticality, informativeness, fluency, length and presence of new words.
